findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed mop to be resting on floor in dry storage area. Discussed with PIC, mop was moved to mop sink hanging area. Ensure mops are stored in a way that prevents any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: Observed 2 coolers to have improper storage order of meats. Eggs and other meats were observed to be stored above salads. Discussed with PIC, meats were relocated to a proper location within cooler. Ensure facility is maintaining proper storage order of meats to prevent any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(2) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (2) Except when combined as ingredients, separating types of raw animal FOODS from each other such as beef, FISH, lamb, pork, and POULTRY during storage, preparation, holding, and display by: (a) Using separate EQUIPMENT for each type, or (b) Arranging each type of FOOD in EQUIPMENT so that cross contamination of one type with another is prevented, and (c) Preparing each type of FOOD at different times or in separate areas.

findings.title: Food properly labeled; original container.
findings.comment: Observed salt, flour, and rice to be missing the proper labeling being contained outside of original container. Discussed with PIC, labels were placed on each container. Ensure any white substance removed from its original container is properly labeled.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.12 Food Storage Containers, Identified with Common Name of Food. Except for containers holding FOOD that can be readily and unmistakably recognized such as dry pasta, working containers holding FOOD or FOOD ingredients that are removed from their original packages for use in the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, such as cooking oils, flour, herbs, potato flakes, salt, spices, and sugar shall be identified with the common name of the FOOD.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment, and linens: properly stored, dried, and handled.
findings.comment: Observed 2 containers of old, soiled utensils to be stored in contact with clean handing ladles. Discussed with PIC, the old utensils were no longer in use and discarded. The ladles were pulled to be placed in dish machine. Ensure clean utensils are stored in a way that prevents any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 4-903.11(A) Equipment, Utensils, Linens, and Single-Service and Single-Use Articles. (A) Except as specified in (D) of this section, cleaned EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, laundered LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be stored: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored.
findings.comment: Observed both ice scoops to be resting on unsanitized surfaces. Discussed with PIC, ice scoops will be cleaned ad placed on a sanitized surface in between use. Ensure in use utensils are stored in a way that prevents any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-304.12(C) In-Use Utensils, Between-Use Storage. During pauses in FOOD preparation or dispensing, FOOD preparation and dispensing UTENSILS shall be stored:(C) On a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food-contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized at a frequency specified under §§ 4-602.11 and 4-702.11.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed caulking to be in a state of disrepair at the hand sink and to the left of dish machine. Discussed with PIC, caulking will be replaced. Ensure facility is monitoring/replacing caulking regularly.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
